column1: # Hand labels for the 80 gaps of the original onSET practice test (answers reconstructed from stumps).
# class: ART PREP CONJ PRON AUX QUANT NEG (= function words) | ADV N V ADJ (= content words)
# cue:   SYN  solved by grammar (agreement, tense, parallelism, article/preposition rules)
#        FIX  solved by a fixed phrase / collocation (a lot of, in fact, such as, taken place)
#        LEX  solved by sentence meaning (several nouns/verbs would fit grammatically)
#        DISC needs information from outside the sentence (topic, earlier sentences)
